uiflow2.firmware_blocker: Exact official StickC Plus firmware identity and image are not acquired; no SE/Plus2 substitution is accepted.

validation.detail: 独立 StickC Plus K016-P 板型候选；精确官方 UIFlow2 固件的同会话启动、显示/LED、输入及外设尚待验证，未继承其它型号 PASS。

blockers: Device-local exact official-firmware boot, input and peripheral data-plane validation is NOT RUN; results from another board are not inherited. A precise official StickC Plus image has not been acquired; service admission is blocked until its board identity and partition map are verified.

service_admission.reason: No precise official UIFlow2 image is available for the original StickC Plus. The separately identified legacy UIFlow1 image is not yet validated; Plus SE and Plus2 firmware must not substitute for it.
